## Description

Before real demographics enter production: update the threat model for P1 features (public site, registration, booking, messaging, TV display), run ASVS L2 checks, the authorisation matrix tests, IDOR tests on patient and appointment endpoints, DAST against staging, dependency/container scan, and a short external review of security-sensitive code.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No open high or critical findings; mediums have dated remediation tickets.
- [ ] **AC2.** IDOR test suite covers every P1 endpoint taking a patient/appointment id.
- [ ] **AC3.** Public endpoints (landing, demo, TV display, webhooks) are rate-limited and pass DAST.
- [ ] **AC4.** The review report is stored in docs/compliance and linked in R1 release notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
